commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Cult of Skaro ({1}{U}{B}{R} 4/4 legendary artifact Dalek, no haste): whenever it attacks, choose one at random: Thay (+1/+1 counter on each artifact creature), Caan (draw two), Sec (3/3 menace Dalek token), Jast (each opponent loses 4). One trigger is worth 1/2 card, 1/4 Dalek and 1 life per opponent in expectation. The deck makes more triggers: clones (Spark Double, Sakashima, Phyrexian Metamorph, Auton Soldier, Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Helm of the Host; the candidate adds Quantum Misalignment and Shaun), trigger copies (Strionic Resonator, Scientist Supreme, Roaming Throne naming Dalek), extra combats (Full Throttle, Great Train Heist, Aggravated Assault; the candidate adds Karlach) and haste (Greaves, Boots, Dalek Emperor; the candidate adds Hammer of Purphoros). An artifact army (Dalek tokens, Thopters, Cybermen, Necrons) turns Thay counters, Master of Etherium, Steel Overseer and combat-damage draw (Research Thief, Thopter Spy Network) into pressure.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (registry source ceiling 4, Optimized; Grok estimate 4). Game Changers: Cyclonic Rift, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Vault, all unchanged; none of the six adds is a Game Changer. Commander Spellbook: baseline and candidate both have exactly one included combo (900-3750 Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault, infinite combat phases, conditional on connecting each combat). No unconditional infinite is claimed.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add multiplies the commander's own attack trigger or its card flow: an every-turn extra combat (Karlach), persistent and rebound Cult copies (Shaun, Quantum Misalignment), haste for each new Cult body (Hammer), Dalek-keyed draw (Kindred Discovery) and team menace (Skorpekh Lord). Generic artifact staples (Foundry Inspector, Cryptothrall, Mirror Box) and off-color cards (Grand Abolisher) were rejected. This keeps Cult a Dalek/Doctor Who attack-trigger deck, distinct from the Grixis artifact-combo and spellslinger decks in the roster.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (93 library rows: Island x3, Mountain x3, Swamp x3, the rest 1x).
Roles:
- 34 lands (28 rows) incl. Academy Ruins, Urza's Saga, Inventors' Fair, Plaza of Heroes, Arena of Glory, Great Furnace, Seat of the Synod, Vault of Whispers, Spire of Industry, Urborg, Training Center, Luxury Suite, Morphic Pool, Xander's Lounge, three fetches and seven duals.
- Ramp: Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Mox Opal, Arcane Signet, Dimir Signet, Fellwar Stone, three Talismans (9 rocks); reducers Etherium Sculptor, Enthusiastic Mechanaut, Shuri.
- Trigger multipliers: Strionic Resonator, Scientist Supreme, Roaming Throne; clones Spark Double, Sakashima, Phyrexian Metamorph, Auton Soldier, Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Helm of the Host, Nanogene Conversion; extra combats Full Throttle, Great Train Heist, Aggravated Assault.
- Haste/protection: Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Padeem, Sword of Feast and Famine.
- Army/payoffs: Dalek Drone, Dalek Squadron, The Dalek Emperor, Davros, Genesis of the Daleks, Doomsday Confluence, Exterminate!, Master of Etherium, Steel Overseer, Cyberman Patrol, Cybermen Squadron, The Master, Multiplied, Ashad, The Cyber-Controller, Missy, Brudiclad, Sai, Biotransference, Thopter Spy Network.
- Card flow: Research Thief, Canoptek Spyder, Thought Monitor, Baleful Strix, Adaptive Omnitool, Emry, Anrakyr.
- Interaction: Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Cyber Conversion, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick, Delete, Desynchronization, Their Name Is Death.
Overlaps: three reducers, two myriad sources whose tokens do not trigger Cult, two haste equipment, several 5+ MV non-trigger payoffs.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline: 34 lands (28 rows; Arena of Glory conditional, Xander's Lounge always tapped); heuristic land sources R 18, B 17, U 17; average nonland MV 3.354; 16 instants/sorceries; 30 creatures incl. Cult. Candidate: 34 lands, sources unchanged (no land swaps); average nonland MV 3.338; 17 instants/sorceries; 28 creatures; rocks 9 (unchanged); artifact reducers 3 -> 2. Kindred Discovery's UU and Hammer's RR rely on 17 blue / 18 red sources plus rocks.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat. Removal: Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick, Cyber Conversion, Dalek Drone, Exterminate!, Delete, Desynchronization (historic-safe), Their Name Is Death (artifacts survive). Protection: Greaves, Boots, Padeem, Sword. Weak points: artifact wipes, Shaun's death exiling all Synths, Kindred overdraw on large token turns.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Cult of Skaro general 135/882, upgraded 8/63, optimized 2/13; M6 Pass C hypothesis (Karlach over Biotransference or Spyder); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {4}{R} 5/4 legendary Tiefling Barbarian: whenever you attack, if it's the first combat phase, untap all attacking creatures, they gain first strike, and there is an additional combat phase.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Cybermen Squadron ({7} 6/6 artifact creature: nonlegendary artifact creatures have myriad). Its myriad tokens enter tapped and attacking, are exiled at end of combat, and never trigger Cult (CR 508.4).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: A second Cult attack trigger every turn, from the turn it lands: Karlach's trigger needs any attacker, not Karlach. Cult and every non-legendary Cult copy (Quantum, Spark Double, Helm, Auton, Irenicus, Shaun's Synth) untap and attack again, so each copy also triggers twice. The second combat also gives Sword of Feast and Famine, Research Thief and Thopter Spy Network a second damage step, and makes Davros's 3-life end-step condition easier. It costs 2 less than Squadron.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: A 5-mana non-artifact body (off-theme for Thay, Master of Etherium, Skorpekh Lord unless Biotransference is out) that does nothing without an attacker. Pass C noted that a second extra-combat source is redundant with Full Throttle, Great Train Heist and Aggravated Assault on the turns those are cast; Karlach is the only permanent one.
material_candidates.reason: The commander's value is its attack trigger; Karlach is the only permanent, every-turn source of a second Cult trigger in Grixis. The bounded test counts 1 -> 2 triggers per turn (3 with Shaun plus haste for the Synth) for 5 mana, against a 7-mana damage-only myriad payoff.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from every Cult of Skaro EDHREC page); M6 Pass C Kindred hypothesis; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {3}{U}{U} enchantment: choose Dalek; whenever a Dalek you control enters or attacks, draw a card.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Canoptek Spyder ({5} 2/2 flyer: draw when another nontoken artifact creature or Vehicle enters). Spyder ignores every Dalek, Thopter, Necron and copy token, which are most of this deck's bodies.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cult, Dalek Drone, Dalek Squadron, The Dalek Emperor, every Cult copy (all Daleks) and the Dalek tokens from Cult's Sec mode, Davros, Genesis of the Daleks, Doomsday Confluence and the Emperor draw on entry and again on each attack, before blockers. With Karlach, each Dalek draws twice in one turn. The bounded measured test (5 fixed boards, hit rates 0..1): Kindred draws 5/4 with Cult alone, 29/4 on a Genesis chapter III turn, and beats Spyder on 4 of 5 boards and Research Thief at every hit rate up to 1/2 on the same 4.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: UU in a deck with 17 heuristic blue land sources and 34 lands; 5 mana for a do-nothing enchantment. Draws are mandatory, so a large Genesis/Confluence turn can overdraw (CR 704.5b deck-out risk, disclosed, not modelled). The deck is deliberately mixed Dalek/Cyberman/Necron (Pass C warning): 15 non-Dalek artifact creatures do not draw.
material_candidates.reason: Pass C asked for a Kindred measured test; the bounded version shows it beats Spyder on every Dalek-containing board, so it takes Spyder's slot (Pass C's other pairing, Kindred over Research Thief, is staged and rejected).

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from every Cult of Skaro EDHREC page); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {1}{R}{R} legendary enchantment artifact: creatures you control have haste; {2}{R}, T, sacrifice a land: create a 3/3 Golem enchantment artifact creature token.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Adaptive Omnitool ({2} equipment: +1/+1 per artifact; on attack, look at six and take an artifact). Equip {3} and it only digs when the equipped creature attacks.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cult has no haste (CR 302.6). Hammer lets Cult attack the turn it is cast from the command zone, including after removal and commander tax, and gives haste to every clone the turn it arrives (Quantum Misalignment including its upkeep rebound copy, Spark Double, Sakashima, Phyrexian Metamorph, Auton Soldier, Irenicus's Vile Duplication). It is an artifact for Mox Opal, affinity and Urza's Saga Construct size; late it turns spare lands into 3/3 artifact attackers for Thay counters and Research Thief.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Only one of several haste sources (Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Brudiclad for tokens, The Dalek Emperor for other Daleks, Arena of Glory). RR pips. Does nothing without creatures.
material_candidates.reason: Global haste turns every new Cult body into an immediate trigger; Omnitool is a slow equip-3 dig that Pass C did not defend.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Cult of Skaro general 331/882, upgraded 21/63, optimized 6/13; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {3}{U}{R} legendary Human Scientist: whenever you attack, you may create a tapped and attacking non-legendary Synth artifact creature copy of target attacking legendary creature you control other than Shaun; when Shaun leaves, exile all Synth tokens.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses The Master, Multiplied ({4}{B}{R} myriad; legend rule off for creature tokens; our triggers can't exile/sacrifice our creature tokens). Its myriad copies enter attacking and do not trigger Cult (508.4); its protection mostly kept Cybermen Squadron's myriad tokens, which are cut as a package.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Each turn Shaun makes another persistent Cult copy (unlike myriad, the Synth stays until Shaun leaves). The copy enters attacking, so it does not trigger that combat, but with Karlach (order Shaun's trigger above Karlach's, CR 603.3b) it is untapped and, given haste from Hammer of Purphoros or The Dalek Emperor (CR 302.6), attacks in the extra combat for a trigger, and on every later turn it is a normal non-legendary Cult that attacks and triggers. Davros, Ashad, Brudiclad, Missy and Karlach are also valid legendary targets when they attack.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Copies only legendary attackers. All Synths are exiled if Shaun dies; a non-artifact 5-drop.
material_candidates.reason: Converts the myriad package (temporary copies that never trigger Cult) into permanent Cult copies that each add an attack trigger from the following combat on.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Cult of Skaro general 379/882, upgraded 28/63, optimized 6/13; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {4}{U} sorcery with rebound: create a non-legendary token copy of target creature you control.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Anrakyr the Traveller ({4}{B} 4/4 legendary Necron: on attack, cast an artifact from hand or graveyard by paying life equal to its MV).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Two non-legendary Cult copies for one card (cast from hand, rebound next upkeep; CR 702.88a). Each copy is a Dalek (Kindred draws, Emperor haste, Roaming Throne) with its own attack trigger. With Hammer or the Emperor the rebound copy attacks that turn.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Sorcery speed, needs Cult (or another creature) on the battlefield, and the copies die to wipes; rebound fails if it was not cast from hand.
material_candidates.reason: Doubles the number of Cult triggers for 5 mana over two turns; Anrakyr's free artifact cast is life-costly and the deck rarely has expensive artifacts in the graveyard.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Six one-for-one swaps that raise Cult attack triggers per turn (Karlach, Shaun, Quantum Misalignment, Hammer of Purphoros), add Dalek-keyed card draw (Kindred Discovery) and team evasion (Skorpekh Lord). Losses: the myriad package (Cybermen Squadron + The Master, Multiplied, incl. the Master's token protection), Spyder's nontoken-entry draws, Omnitool's artifact dig, Anrakyr's free artifact casting and one of three artifact reducers (Etherium Sculptor).

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: OFF-RANKING or low-inclusion: Kindred Discovery, Hammer of Purphoros and Karlach (selected); Reckless Fireweaver, Hexplate Wallbreaker, Combat Celebrant, World at War (rejected).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected six-swap package: more Cult attack triggers per turn (Karlach's extra combat, Shaun's persistent copies, Quantum's two copies, Hammer's haste for every new Cult body), pre-damage Dalek card flow (Kindred Discovery) and team evasion (Skorpekh Lord). Lands stay at 34; rocks stay at 9.
Staged five-swap alternative keeping Etherium Sculptor. Retained: keeps a third reducer but loses team menace for the combat-damage payoffs.
Staged four-swap alternative keeping the myriad package (Cybermen Squadron + The Master, Multiplied). Rejected: myriad copies never trigger Cult (508.4).
Staged Pass C Kindred pairing: Kindred over Research Thief, Spyder kept. Rejected by the bounded draw test.
Staged Pass C Karlach pairing: Karlach over Biotransference, Cybermen Squadron kept. Rejected: Biotransference makes Shaun, Karlach and clones artifacts and creates Necrons.
Staged seven-swap list adding Combat Celebrant over Thought Monitor. Rejected: redundant extra combat for a card-draw flyer.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C paired Kindred Discovery with Research Thief and Karlach with Biotransference or Canoptek Spyder. Here Kindred takes Spyder's slot and Karlach takes Cybermen Squadron's; both Pass C pairings are staged as complete six-swap 100s and rejected (Thief beats Kindred on non-Dalek or fully connecting boards; Biotransference supports the non-artifact adds).
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The commander's value is its attack trigger, yet the baseline spent 13 mana on a myriad package whose tokens never trigger Cult, had no permanent extra-combat source, no global haste for new Cult copies, and card draw keyed to nontoken entries (Spyder) or an equip-3 dig (Omnitool).
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Six swaps: an every-turn extra combat (Karlach), persistent and rebound Cult copies (Shaun, Quantum Misalignment), global haste (Hammer), Dalek-keyed draw (Kindred Discovery, supported by the bounded measured test) and team menace (Skorpekh Lord). The Spellbook combo set is unchanged (900-3750 only).

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Commander first, then lines alphabetically (Island x3, Mountain x3, Swamp x3). Six substitutions against the canonical source. 34 lands; 100 physical cards verified by quantity (99 library + 1 commander).

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five-swap floor, Skorpekh Lord over Etherium Sculptor was added as a sixth swap, and every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool. Ten post-floor challenges were recorded and rejected on Cult-specific grounds; one larger seven-swap package (Combat Celebrant over Thought Monitor) is staged as a complete 100.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Celebrant gives a third extra-combat source, but it must attack and exert; Thought Monitor draws two on an affinity artifact flyer that often costs 1-3.
Wallbreaker adds a combat only once moved to Cult for 9 total mana; Biotransference makes every creature an artifact and creates a Necron per artifact spell.
Production copies Cult each upkeep, but as an aura on our key creature it is a 2-for-1 risk, and the owner already cut it; Confluence is a flexible wipe/army/draw spell.
Rising adds global haste, which Hammer of Purphoros already gives; Boots also give Cult hexproof against spot removal.
Fireweaver pings per artifact entry, but gives no cards or bodies; Spy Network makes a flyer each upkeep and draws per connecting combat.
Cryptothrall protects artifact creatures only; Padeem protects every artifact and draws when we control the most expensive artifact.
Mirror Box turns off the legend rule without adding a body; Sakashima is also a triggering Cult copy.
World at War spreads one extra combat over two turns; Full Throttle's two extra combats in one turn is the finisher.
Inspector reduces artifact costs from turn four on; Fellwar Stone ramps every spell including Cult's colored cost.
Weeping Angel stops being a creature whenever an opponent casts a creature; Strix is a cheap cantrip deathtouch flyer.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Adds a third extra-combat source for turns when Karlach is not available, so Cult triggers on more turns.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Karlach already supplies the extra combat every turn; Celebrant exerts and dies to any blocker, and Thought Monitor's card draw matters more.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at six; the five-swap floor was not used as a target. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on deck-specific grounds: cheap affinity draw (Thought Monitor), artifact typing and Necrons for the non-artifact adds (Biotransference), a flexible wipe/army spell (Doomsday Confluence), hexproof plus haste on Cult (Swiftfoot Boots), per-combat draw (Thopter Spy Network), all-artifact protection (Padeem), a triggering clone that also fixes the legend rule (Sakashima), the three-combat finisher (Full Throttle), early ramp (Fellwar Stone) and a cheap cantrip blocker (Baleful Strix).
